projects.name: AdventureWorks Enterprise Data Warehouse
projects.summary: In-progress enterprise data warehouse project that transforms AdventureWorks transactional data into an analytics-ready dimensional model with controlled and observable data loads.
projects.problem: Operational data is distributed across normalized transactional structures that are not optimized for historical analysis, consistent business metrics or repeatable analytical workloads.
highlights: Designing fact and dimension tables around analytical business processes
Developing ETL workflows with incremental loading strategies
Modeling Slowly Changing Dimensions for historical traceability
Adding audit and execution logging for observable pipeline runs

projects.name: E-Commerce Data Engineering Platform
projects.summary: In-progress data engineering platform that simulates an e-commerce operational source and establishes a reproducible foundation for incremental ingestion and downstream data pipelines.
projects.problem: E-commerce data originates from interdependent operational entities and changes continuously, requiring a reliable source model and repeatable environment before analytical pipelines can be developed safely.
highlights: Modeling an OLTP source for customers, products, orders and related transactions
Containerizing the local environment for reproducible development
Generating and processing source data with Python
Building the platform incrementally to keep components testable and documented
